decisions.briefing: It was a broad risk-off day: the NASDAQ fell 2.3% and the S&P 500 fell 2.0%, and the screener returned no candidates. We are holding all 7 positions and making no new buys. Our holdings together are worth about what we paid for them, and the automatic stop-losses at -7% will protect against a deeper drop. The $546 in cash stays as reserve until the market turns risk-on again.

market_education.summary_en: Stocks sold off across the board today: the NASDAQ fell 2.3% and the S&P 500 fell 2.0%, so the market classified the day as risk-off. Tech and growth stocks fell the most, which is common when investors become more cautious and move money out of higher-risk holdings. No news headlines were supplied for this session, so this summary does not name a specific cause and relies only on the index moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股全面受壓，納斯達克指數下跌2.3%，標普500指數亦跌2.0%，市場整體轉向避險模式。科技及成長股跌幅較大，反映投資者風險胃納收縮，資金從高風險資產撤離。由於本節未有提供相關新聞標題，以上分析僅根據指數走勢，未能指出具體觸發因素。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth and tech stocks, so the broad market falls together. On days like this, many disciplined investors stop opening new positions. They keep their existing holdings, protected by stop-losses, and wait for conditions to improve before buying again.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨謹慎，紛紛拋售科技股、成長股等較高風險資產，令大市普遍下跌。遇上這類日子，不少紀律嚴謹的投資者會暫停建立新倉位，現有持倉則交由止蝕機制保障，待市況回穩後才再入市。
